call_points.text: Spinning is sold forward about 90-95 days in exports and 45-50 days domestic; April-May price gains should show in Q2.
US fabric orders were lost to a missed sampling season; business has improved in the last month and better volumes are expected in 2-3 months.
Dhar PM MITRA land expected by December, but construction waits for power, which management does not expect before June 2027.
Asked for cotton inventory levels, management declined to share them.
Asked to quantify the margin moderation, management said it could not give numbers, citing uncertainty over inventory and yarn prices.
About 12-13 million spindles closed permanently in India over three years, with little new capacity announced, supporting spinning economics.

operating_notes.text: Vardhman Textiles is acquiring 31.2% in ReNew Green (MPR Four) for ₹24.29 Cr for a 19 MW AC hybrid captive power plant.
Capitalized new technical textile unit in Baddi and additional processing line in Budhni aggregating ₹570 crores in March 2026.
Approved garment unit capacity expansion in Punjab from 2.20 million to 4.50 million shirts p.a. for ₹125 crore by FY27.
Total announced capex stands at ₹3,660 crore covering yarn, green initiatives, and garment expansions.
Working spinning capacity in India estimated at 41-42 million spindles down from 53 million due to permanent closures of ~11-11.5 million spindles.
Chinese yarn demand has increased monthly offtake from India to ~30 million kg from historical 7-8 million kg.
Spinning spreads improved to $0.90-$0.95 per kg from $0.60-$0.65 per kg lows.
Q1FY27 cotton-yarn spread was about USD0.90 per kg against a historical USD0.85-1.00 and USD0.60-0.70 in the last 2-3 years.
Spinning order book is about 90-95 days in exports and 45-50 days domestic; one-third of yarn goes to exports, one-third domestic and one-third captive.
China and Bangladesh take about 60% of India's yarn exports; India's monthly yarn exports rose to about 110 million kg from under 100 million kg.

timeline.summary: Vardhman Textiles approved acquiring a 31.2% stake in ReNew Green (MPR Four) for ₹24.29 Cr to source captive hybrid power.
Vardhman Textiles approved the expansion of its garment unit capacity in Punjab for ₹125 crore on May 7, 2026.
Vardhman Textiles reported FY26 standalone revenue of ₹9,652 Cr and PAT of ₹740 Cr, down 16% YoY.
Vardhman Textiles Limited shared the audio recording link for its 4QFY26 conference call held on 08-May-2026 at 04:00 PM.
Vardhman Textiles held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 8, 2026, discussing industry spreads, capacity rationalization, and export demand.
S.P. Oswal declared no encumbrance on Vardhman Textiles’ promoter shares by PAC for FY 2025-26 as of 31.03.2026.
Vardhman Textiles executed an amended shareholder agreement for its renewable energy JV, revising subscription amounts to ₹24.46 Cr for the user and ₹53.41 Cr for the promoter.
Vardhman Textiles completed a ₹24.46 Cr investment for a 31.2% stake in Renew Green (MPR Four) Private Limited.
